description: backup-trigger-prune.md's success-response shape is a JSON ARRAY containing one object (`[{"task_name": "PRUNE-..."}]`). backup-trigger-backup.md and backup-trigger-merge.md, structurally identical 'trigger an immediate task now' endpoints with the same request shape (repository-id path parameter, Full Admin role, 200 OK plus a task_name), both return a single bare OBJECT instead (`{"task_name": "BACKUP-..."}` / `{"task_name": "MERGE-..."}`). Possibly because a single prune call can retroactively affect multiple expired backups and therefore may spawn more than one task, but no page states that explanation - the asymmetry is simply present, unexplained, across the three otherwise-parallel endpoints.
